This environment highlights one of TurboRegime's central design tradeoffs. The strategy is engineered to recognize changes in momentum quickly, allowing it to increase exposure when conditions improve and reduce exposure when they deteriorate. That responsiveness can be particularly valuable during sustained market trends.

Choppy markets present a different challenge. When momentum repeatedly changes direction without establishing a lasting trend, the system can experience short-duration trades and whipsaws. The objective during these periods is not necessarily to capture every market fluctuation, but to preserve capital and remain positioned for the next sustained advance.

TurboRegime does not attempt to predict those outcomes. Its established algorithm remains unchanged, and the system will continue adjusting exposure according to its confirmed signals.
